title: Act: Add the typed event bus module
summary: Create events.ts with event maps and a generic typed emitter.
description: Implement a dependency-free typed bus and two exported instances.
acceptance_criteria: Given the module, When read, Then it declares both event maps and createEventBus.
Given the module, When read, Then it has no phaser import.
technical_constraints: Generic over an event map type

steps.symbol: new: PhaserToReactEvents, ReactToPhaserEvents, createEventBus, phaserToReact, reactToPhaser
steps.action: Declare interface PhaserToReactEvents {objectHover:{id:string|null}; objectClick:{id:string}; sceneReady:{sceneId:string}} and interface ReactToPhaserEvents {highlightObject:{id:string|null}; playAnimation:{target:string;name:string}; transitionTo:{sceneId:string}}. Implement createEventBus<T extends object>() using a Map<keyof T, Set<handler>> returning {on(event, handler): () => void, off(event, handler), emit(event, payload), clear()}. Export const phaserToReact = createEventBus<PhaserToReactEvents>() and reactToPhaser = createEventBus<ReactToPhaserEvents>().
steps.expected: Typed on/emit compile; emit with a wrong payload fails tsc.
